name: Zipstick
body:
Source Technology Guide pg. 53
Price 20 gp
Slot none; Weight 1 lb.
Capacity 10; Usage 1 charge
Description
A zipstick is a small pen-like device used to administer a small jolt of electricity. This jolt is enough to cause 1 point of nonlethal damage with a successful touch attack. A zipstick is used most often to activate or deactivate items that function on ion-bonding technology, such as ion tape (see page 48).
Construction
Craft DC 18; Cost 10 gp
Craft Technological Item, production lab
